messages:
ryan: Heads up — we're running a hybrid HackNight at the NYC studio on May 14. Need final booth plan, speaker intake, swag order, lead routing, and follow-up webinar plan. Quick sync today?

emily: +1. Are we taking speaker submissions via Typeform or direct DM?

ryan: Typeform preferred. Sam set up a short form last week: https://airtable.com/shrFakeLink

sam: Form is live, required fields: name, talk title, short abstract, in-person? remote? preferred slot. I'll share link in the event page.

leah: Swag list draft: stickers (2k), tshirts (L/XL mix 200), mini charger powerbanks 50, postcards 500. Budget?

marie: That feels heavy. Can we cut to 1k stickers, 100 shirts, 30 powerbanks? ROI on powerbanks low.

nico: Recommend adding a QR card with CTA to the benchmark report. We'll route scan->zapier->HubSpot list 'hacknight_leads'.

anna: HubSpot workflow: create list + assign to inbound SDR queue 'events-nyc'. Need the form field mapping.

sam: mapping: email->contact.email, company->company, role->jobtitle, interest->lead_source, code_of_conduct->consent.

ryan: Ops: who's owning pick-up logistics and courier day-of? We can't afford lost swag.

jamie: I'll own pickups. Plan: ship to office (arrive May 12), boxed pallets, courier (GoreCourier) on May 14 morning. I'll post tracking.

ops-bot: reminder: swag_order should be placed 7 days before event.

sam: Placed initial order with merch vendor. Order# M-78921. ETA May 11. Items: stickers 1000, shirts 100, postcards 500, powerbanks 30. Invoice attached: https://invoices.example/M-78921.pdf

leah: Can we do a small "benchmark postcard" with 3 bullet stats and QR link? keeps the bench narrative on-hand.

marie: yes. design to be ready by May 6. @design-team please prioritize.

ryan: Webinar follow-up: plan is 2 weeks post-event — "HackNight: live demos + Redwood benchmarks" 45 min + Q&A. Who can host?

nico: I can host, will run a short 15-min benchmark walk-through and 20-min panel w/ 2 speakers.

anna: I'll lock webinar landing page and setup auto emails. Need speaker bios and headshots by May 8.

ryan: Lead routing: priority leads flagged if they attend in-person and scan QR + request follow-up. SDR to reach out within 48h.

jamie: Day-of checklist snippet:
```
May 14 | 08:00 - load-in
10:00 - booth opens
11:30 - demo slots start
15:00 - lightning talk stage
18:00 - teardown
```

sam: demo rotation schedule: 20m slots, 5m changeover. I'll run calendar invites for demo volunteers.

marie: Can we get a small 'staff cheat sheet' with talking points: 1) Redwood inference one-liner 2) benchmark top stat 3) pricing pointer 4) call-to-action (scan QR)

ryan: I'll draft cheat sheet and post later today. Also need volunteers: 2 AM, 2 PM, 1 teardown. Sign-up: https://signup.example/nyc-hacknight

leah: Thanks — can we also confirm power needs? 2x power strips, extension cords, laptop charger for demo rig.

jamie: noted. bringing power strips + multi-USB charger.

ops-bot: webhook: order M-78921 status updated -> 'shipped'

sam: vendor says shipped, tracking: GC123456789US

marie: last ask: can we get small giveaways for top demo winners? $100 in gift cards x3.

ryan: approved. budget tracker updated.

nico: final note — let's capture demo recordings and push to YouTube + snippets for social. ops for recorded permission on form?

sam: added checkbox on Typeform: 'I consent to recording and repost' (default off).

ryan: Perfect. Thanks everyone. If no objections I'll lock orders and speaker invites by EOD.

emily: :thumbsup:
